cookies.name: __Host-fcr_session
cookies.purpose: Carry a high-entropy opaque Founder Control Room browser-session capability whose authoritative credentials, expiry, rotation, and revocation state remain server-side.
cookies.integrity: 256-bit server-issued random capability; only its SHA-256 lookup hash is persisted and the cookie grants no authority without active server-side session state.
cookies.csrf: Approved same-origin browser context is required for privileged mutations; founder authority remains separately gated by FCR policy.
cookies.deletion: Cleared by POST /auth/logout, session rotation failure, and failed or disallowed browser-session verification. Server-side logout also records revocation.

cookies.name: fcr_session
cookies.purpose: Legacy founder-session cookie name retained only as an explicit deletion target during migration to the __Host-fcr_session opaque capability.
cookies.integrity: Never accepted for authentication after opaque-session cutover; emitted only with Max-Age=0 to remove historical self-contained token cookies.
cookies.csrf: Not accepted as an authentication or authorization input.
cookies.deletion: Expired whenever a new opaque session is issued or any founder browser session is cleared.

nonCookieState: founder_browser_sessions: service-role-only server-side session state keyed by a SHA-256 hash of the opaque browser capability
prohibited: client-readable founder auth tokens in the FCR browser-session cookie
self-contained access or refresh token payloads in founder session cookies
caching any response that writes, rotates, or clears the founder session
